SELECT user.id , user.deleted , user.created_at as createdAt , user.modified_at as modifiedAt
, user.username , user.name , user.nickname , user.phone , user.birth , user.gender FROM user WHERE user.id is not null AND user.username = #{username} AND user.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') ORDER BY user.id ORDER BY user.name DESC ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{perpage}
